newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125 lbs ld 72.00 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.

Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Thursdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady in a light test. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 117.00-118.00 ld 115.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 2 ld 107.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 108.00-109.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 101.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs few 117.00-118.00 ld 115.00.
